description: We are a team of curious students passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation. We aim to use NASA’s open data, AI/ML, and data science to develop creative solutions to real-world challenges. We value teamwork, creativity, and hands-on learning, and welcome members skilled in programming, research, data analysis, UI/UX design, or presentation. Together, we hope to explore new ideas, learn, and build impactful solutions.
